solve_linear_assignment: solve the linear assignment problem using the Hungarian algorithm on a cost matrix to find minimum-cost row-column pairs
run_hungarian_algorithm: run the Hungarian algorithm on a rectangular cost matrix to compute a minimum-cost maximum-cardinality bipartite matching
find_augmenting_path: find an augmenting path in the bipartite graph using DFS with potential updates for the Hungarian algorithm
compute_row_assignment: compute optimal row-to-column assignments by iterating over rows with JAX lax.scan and backtracking DFS paths
test_hungarian_algorithm: test the Hungarian algorithm on a 4x3 cost matrix and verify the minimum total assignment cost is 15
